name: schedula
description: Dev-only tooling for Schedula. The shipped product is a single static index.html with zero build step and zero runtime npm dependency (SheetJS is loaded from its own CDN inside index.html, in-browser). These devDependencies exist purely to run the regression tests in tests/ against data/Offered_Course_Report.xlsx before each deploy.

scripts.test: node tests/test_parser.js && node tests/test_dom.js && node tests/test_coinstructor.js
